proposition.claim:
Pages 20–21, equations (71)–(76), seek to verify the nonconcentration hypothesis of Theorem 13 for \[\Phi(t)=
 \begin{pmatrix}
 t&-\sigma t^2-4(1-\sigma)\\1&-t
 \end{pmatrix},\qquad \sigma\ne1.\] The argument asserts that every proper subgroup of \(\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbf F_p)\) has trivial second derived group and reduces the verification to a double commutator. It also specifies a scalar normalization and a family \(g_t\). Three exact checks show that this verification cannot be accepted as written.

Recorded check: All printed hypotheses hold; x^2-x+1=(x-4)(x-10), two vertical tori.

Recorded check: Nonidentity PGL2 map permutes all t roots; t/t^(3/4) unbounded.
